decisions.statement: A phone asks this route alone whether the secret that phone has is still good.
The route judges the credential alone.
No route-access hold and no grant lookup comes between the ask and the answer.
Nothing here fails closed on a store outage.
A store admitting the secret answers 200.
A store refusing the secret answers 401.
A store that did not answer at all answers 503.

definition: whether the secret a phone has is still one the store admits
